mapper.select: SELECT t.trainer_id AS trainerId, t.title, t.description, t.price, t.category, t.level, t.total_score AS totalScore, t.average_rating AS averageRating, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e2.user_id) FROM enrollments e2 WHERE e2.training_id = t.training_id) AS traineeCount, u.username AS trainerNickname, u.user_profile_url AS trainerProfileUrl, e.progress, e.enrollment_id AS enrollmentId FROM trainings t JOIN enrollments e ON e.training_id = t.training_id JOIN users u ON t.trainer_id = u.user_id WHERE t.training_id = #{trainingId} AND e.user_id = #{userId}

SELECT r.routine_id AS routineId, r.title, r.routine_type AS routineType, r.quiz_type AS quizType, r.score AS rewardPoint, lr.status AS completed, lr.submitted_at AS completedAt FROM routines r /* 수강행 먼저 확정 (userId, trainingId) */ JOIN enrollments e ON e.training_id = r.training_id AND e.user_id = #{userId} /* 루틴×수강별 최신 결과만 붙이기 */ LEFT JOIN ( SELECT rr.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY rr.routine_id, rr.enrollment_id ORDER BY rr.submitted_at DESC, rr.routine_result_id DESC ) AS rn FROM routine_results rr ) lr ON lr.routine_id = r.routine_id AND lr.enrollment_id = e.enrollment_id AND lr.rn = 1 WHERE r.training_id = #{trainingId} ORDER BY r.order_number ASC

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT rr.routine_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY rr.routine_id, rr.enrollment_id ORDER BY rr.submitted_at DESC, rr.routine_result_id DESC ) AS rn, rr.status FROM routine_results rr JOIN enrollments e ON e.enrollment_id = rr.enrollment_id AND e.training_id = #{trainingId} AND e.user_id = #{userId} ) x WHERE x.rn = 1 AND x.status = TRUE

SELECT t.training_id AS trainingId, t.title, u.username AS trainerName, t.average_rating AS averageRating, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e2.user_id) FROM enrollments e2 WHERE e2.training_id = t.training_id) AS traineeCount, t.price, t.thumbnail_url AS thumbnailUrl, t.level, t.category, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM enrollments e3 WHERE e3.training_id = t.training_id AND e3.user_id = #{userId} ) THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS purchased FROM trainings t JOIN users u ON t.trainer_id = u.user_id WHERE t.approval_status = '승인' ORDER BY t.created_at DESC

SELECT t.trainer_id AS trainerId, t.title, t.description, t.price, t.category, t.level, t.average_rating AS averageRating, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e2.user_id) FROM enrollments e2 WHERE e2.training_id = t.training_id) AS traineeCount, u.username AS trainerNickname, u.user_profile_url AS trainerProfileUrl, t.thumbnail_url AS thumbnailUrl, IFNULL(SUM(r.score),0) AS totalRoutineScore FROM trainings t JOIN users u ON t.trainer_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN routines r ON t.training_id = r.training_id WHERE t.training_id = #{trainingId} AND t.approval_status = '승인' GROUP BY t.training_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reviews (user_id, training_id, rating, content) VALUES (#{userId}, #{trainingId}, #{rating}, #{content})
